== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Slave I, Symbol Of Fear (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Slave_I_Symbol_Of_Fear.png]]) shows the original text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-slaveisymboloffear-pre.gif]]) shows a third wording.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May reveal from hand to take a [Virtual Block 8] Fett from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; and deploy both simultaneously. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Your [Virtual Block 8] Fetts deploy -2 aboard. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>601_24</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
